gap_dispositions.decision: Carry speaker, archive, addressee, coercive condition, genre, and represented-party standing separately from claim content.
gap_dispositions.reason: Source citation alone cannot expose whose voice survives, who mediates it, or which authority constrained its form.

gap_dispositions.decision: Preserve situated intellectual dependence and the right to refuse synthesis; never score mixture as inclusion by default.
gap_dispositions.reason: Identity and composition owners can turn conquest or nation-building into a neutral merge.

gap_dispositions.decision: Carry affected-party voice as more than a system-assigned stakeholder role, with material, validity, participation, and feasibility checks.
gap_dispositions.reason: Evaluation can absorb the exterior voice if the evaluating system defines every party and admissible claim.

gap_dispositions.decision: Require named classification, institution, labor relation, subject position, historical mechanism, and dissent before applying a coloniality view.
gap_dispositions.reason: A global coloniality label can be illuminating but cannot substitute for causal or historical specificity.

gap_dispositions.decision: Carry co-produced category power and coalition without reducing intersection to tag conjunction or coalition to consensus.
gap_dispositions.reason: Race, gender, sexuality, class, labor, body, and human status are institutionally related rather than independent filters.

gap_dispositions.decision: Retain nonadditive transformation and a scoped right-to-opacity limit alongside accountable claims.
gap_dispositions.reason: Transparent representation and hybrid labels lose unpredictable relation, plantation history, and culturally instituted genres of the human.

gap_dispositions.decision: Keep Indigenous, Spanish, Portuguese, French, English, Creole, Afro-diasporic, national, Caribbean, and academic positions separable.
gap_dispositions.reason: One Latin American or decolonial owner would erase the exclusions and internal corrections that make the comparison useful.

scope_debt: Haiti, Cuba, Puerto Rico, Central America, Andes, Southern Cone, Guianas, and Dutch Caribbean depth
additional women, queer, disability, ecological, analytic, scientific, and religious philosophy
land and reparative justice with qualified authority
additional Caribbean linguistic and diasporic positions
primary-language and community-qualified review before admission

product_value.reader: A reader comparing identity, authenticity, liberation, coloniality, gender, race, relation, or mixture across Latin American and Caribbean contexts.
product_value.job: See who speaks through which archive, language, genre, and address; which concrete power relation governs the claim; and where synthesis or transparency must stop.
product_value.current_friction: Current owners normalize archives, model mixture additively, define affected parties internally, and treat missing transparency as incomplete data.
product_value.smallest_future_product_change: After GPC-09, expose only recurring archive/address, affected-party, category-coproduction, mechanism, or opacity facets.
product_value.evidence_now: Source review and structural validation only.
product_value.evidence_later: Primary-language, community-qualified, and reader comprehension review.
product_value.cost_and_displacement: Six immutable records add custody; premature entries risk Hispanic default, archival appropriation, assimilation, and political prescription.
product_value.continue_merge_stop: Proceed to GPC-08; merge no local records; stop GPC-07 content work.

stop: Freeze GPC-07 custody and execute GPC-08; reserve global alignment and content decisions for GPC-09.
